tasks.answer: DeleteDiscussion is the destructive confirm control for deleting a discussion; it wraps the shared ConfirmationDialog (triggerButton, confirmButton, title).
Input takes react-hook-form's registration (register('email')) as the required registration prop; label/error are rendered via FieldWrapper, so it must be used inside Form.
DiscussionsList's pagination is TablePagination, which builds page hrefs from rootUrl and needs totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl.
MDPreview renders Markdown bodies from the value prop, sanitized with DOMPurify (do not pass pre-rendered HTML).
CreateDiscussion is the admin-only drawer form (title + Markdown body); it requires the Authorization provider and only admins see the trigger.

notes: One search per task (5) + one combined get for 3 IDs (registration binding, value prop, admin constraint); no --include props, no source reads. Budget held (<=1 get/task, never repeated an ID). 6 catalog calls logged in usage/catalog-2.jsonl.
